note: Presets are described by visual attributes, never by the name of a game, studio, or franchise. Two reasons: hosted image APIs degrade or refuse on named-IP prompts, and a preset named after someone else's property is a trademark liability in a shipping product. Keep the franchise name in 'internalReference' for your own orientation and never send it to a model or show it to a user.

presets.internalReference: Visual target: early-2000s open-world game key art and loading screens. Not for use in prompts.

attributes.lineWeight: heavy, uniform-weight black contour on every form; interior detail lines much thinner
attributes.lineRoughness: clean vector-like edges, no sketch texture
attributes.shading: flat cel shading, two to three tones per surface, one hard-edged highlight
attributes.palette: desaturated warm neutrals with one saturated accent per character; muted ochre, olive, dusty teal, off-white
attributes.contrast: high between subject and background, low within the background
attributes.facialDetail: medium; defined brow, nasolabial and jaw lines, simplified skin with no pores or blemish detail
attributes.realismVsStylisation: stylised proportions with accurate individual likeness; graphic simplification without physical caricature
attributes.backgroundTreatment: flat blocked shapes, reduced saturation, no fine detail, no text; identifiable as a place but never competing with the face
attributes.preferredFraming: chest-up three-quarter portrait, head occupying the upper 55% of the frame, generous headroom for cropping

positive: desaturated warm neutral palette with a single accent colour
simplified flat blocked background, low saturation

renderTargets.rationale: Close shots crop to roughly 1500px and extreme shots to 1920px of a 1080p frame. The existing zayavka-v1 assets are ~1250px and therefore already upscale 1.15x–1.47x on close-ups, which is visible as softness. Any future push-in multiplies the problem.

model.note: Deliberately unset. The pipeline is built against the expression-descriptor contract, not against a model. Fill this in when the compute resource is known.

plannedPresets.note: Additional presets are data, not code: a new entry here plus optional model/adapter config, with no change to the storyboard schema or any renderer. Describe each by attributes only, for the reasons in the header note.
